name: @loom/plugin-mcp-app
description: MCP Apps (SEP-1865, `io.modelcontextprotocol/ui`) egress — projects a Loom agent surface onto the extension as ONE static, content-pinned surface-host template whose payload is the existing A2UI catalog model, plus an app-visibility surface cursor tool that closes the extension's missing server-push channel. Egress only: the host role (iframe, CSP, postMessage) is deliberately out of scope.
